verdict.rationale: Steel's docs describe built-in Managed Residential Proxies and Bring Your Own Proxy, with a dedicated proxies and proxy-rotation page, plus a Dedicated IPs option. Stealth is listed as a core capability alongside CAPTCHA solving, and a community comment confirms custom proxies can be used. However, the stealth fingerprinting itself appears only as a one-word mention in summaries, with no detail on how fingerprints are configured. missing for 10: documented fingerprint-randomization or stealth configuration details, explicit geo/country targeting for proxies, independent hands-on evidence that sessions avoid bot detection.
